description: This file defines the interface ProductOptionDao for data access operations related to ProductOption entities in the e-commerce platform, including methods for listing, retrieving by name or code, saving, and getting read-only attributes.

classes.name: ProductOptionDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for ProductOption entities, providing methods to query and manipulate product options in the store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOption objects associated with a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOption objects by store, name, and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new ProductOption or updates an existing one, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves a list of read-only ProductOption objects for the given store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOption by store and option code.
